lines.trans: Two warm cinnamon rolls as my gift for my best soup-and-bread crew!
Sit down for a minute, Rocio: Javier has big news to tell us.
Wait: don't tell me they cancelled your Saturday morning train, Javier!
Better yet: I am only taking that train to pack my boxes and move back here.

No way! You are opening your acoustic design studio on our street?!

From a swapped blue suitcase on Monday to neighbours for good!

poder.gloss: can; to be able to; may

examples.text: Vemos los rollos desde la puerta.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

meanings.en: always (siempre que = whenever / as long as)

meanings.en: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: vuelvo), past participle vuelto; volverse + adj = become.

examples.trans: I will be back in five minutes.
He smiled again right away.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.
It is quarter past seven.
